audience: developers and ops teams who monitor cron jobs and backups with Healthchecks.io

useCases.title: See which checks are down
useCases.text: The AI lists the checks of a project, filtered by slug or tags, with status, schedule and last ping. You get the failing ones first.

useCases.title: Find when a check went down and came back
useCases.text: The AI reads a check's flips (status changes) over a lookback window or a date range. You see the outages in time order.

useCases.title: Inspect the recent pings of a check
useCases.text: The AI lists a check's logged pings with type, date and duration, and reads the body of a single ping as plain text.

useCases.title: Create or update a check
useCases.text: The AI creates a check with a timeout or a cron schedule, or changes an existing one. It can assign notification integrations.

useCases.title: Pause or resume checks during maintenance
useCases.text: The AI pauses the checks you name so they stop going down, and resumes them when the work is done.

useCases.title: List notification integrations and status badges
useCases.text: The AI lists the project's notification integrations with their kind, and the status-badge URLs per tag.
